question: Should OpenClaw move from one exclusive memory slot to public purpose-specific memory role slots as proposed by the linked implementation PR?
rationale: Current main confirms the architectural limitation, but the requested fix adds public config/API surface and crosses VISION.md's current one-memory-slot direction, so automation cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Sponsor role slots
options.body: Accept the multi-role memory direction and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 for migration, docs, and compatibility readiness.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Ask for a smaller plugin API or dreaming/coexistence seam first, leaving full role slots for a later RFC.

options.title: Keep one slot
options.body: Reject broad multi-slot memory for now and document the supported one-slot plus plugin-side composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor role slots
recommendation.body: Accept the multi-role memory direction and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 for migration, docs, and compatibility readiness.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the original memory slot plugin behavior and is the strongest available routing signal for the product/API direction.
